resolutions.required_change: In `tasks.md` `7.2` (and `7.1` boundary cases): state explicitly that (1) if `deps.config.state.status !== "ready"`, the callback returns `undefined` immediately with no side effects; (2) for each `item` in `staged`, look up `const candidate = candidates.findLast((c) => c.entryId === item.id)`, then look up the last `ToolResultMessage` in `event.toolResults` whose `toolCallId === candidate.toolCallId`, defaulting `content` to `[]` if either lookup misses; and (3) the callback returns `undefined`.
resolutions.rationale: Valid zero-decision gap (`implementation-readiness-standard.md` §1): `ArchivedToolOutput` returned by `stageToolOutputs` has `id` (`candidate.entryId`) and no `toolCallId`, yet `7.2` references 'the candidate's' `toolCallId` without naming the `entryId === item.id` join, its miss fallback, or the non-`ready` guard return.

resolutions.evidence: Measured in a `git archive HEAD` copy under `mktemp -d` (`npm run check` green in ~35 ms): `ModelRuntime.create({ authPath: join(agentDir, "auth.json"), modelsPath: null, allowModelNetwork: false, refreshOnCreate: false })` + `registerNativeProvider(faux.provider)` needs no `setRuntimeApiKey`; `pi.registerTool` in `helperExtension` works with `let activeSession: AgentSession | undefined`; `void activeSession?.abort()` in `execute` needs 1 `toolUse` response while settled `10.1` needs 2 (`toolUse` + `stop`); `keepRecentTokens: 0` with `compaction.enabled: false` after a second short prompt places `taiknr-side-store` at branch index 7 before `firstKeptEntryId` at index 10 and consumes 2 summary responses (`isSplitTurn === true`); openspec/changes/archive-stubbing-and-branch-hydration/tasks.md:187-227
resolutions.rationale: Valid zero-decision failure (`implementation-readiness-standard.md` §1): Group 10 leaves five harness mechanics marked 'not found ... confirm and ask' (plus `10.1` queues only the `toolUse` turn without the follow-up `stop` turn, and `10.4` queues 1 summary response after 1 prompt where `keepRecentTokens: 0` actually places `firstKeptEntryId` before `taiknr-side-store` and requires 2 summary responses). Every one of those mechanics was measured against Pi 1.5.2 in a `mktemp -d` copy and can be fixed verbatim in `tasks.md`.
resolutions.required_change:
Remove the 'not found ... confirm and ask' branches in `tasks.md` Group 10 and pin the measured recipes directly:
1. Group 10 intro: pass `authPath: join(agentDir, "auth.json")` to `ModelRuntime.create({ authPath: join(agentDir, "auth.json"), modelsPath: null, allowModelNetwork: false, refreshOnCreate: false })`, omit `setRuntimeApiKey` (verified unnecessary for `faux.provider`), and pass `noSkills: true, noPromptTemplates: true, noThemes: true` alongside `noExtensions: true` on `DefaultResourceLoader`.
2. `10.1`: register the tool via `pi.registerTool({ name: "big_out", label: "Big Out", description: "Returns big output", parameters: { type: "object", properties: {} } as never, execute: async () => ... })` inside `helperExtension`, holding `let activeSession: AgentSession | undefined` assigned right after `createAgentSession(...)`, and queue two responses for the settled tool run: `[fauxAssistantMessage([fauxToolCall("big_out", {}, { id: "call-1" })], { stopReason: "toolUse" }), fauxAssistantMessage([fauxText("done")], { stopReason: "stop" })]`.
3. `10.2`: when a test-local `abortInTool` boolean is `true`, `execute` calls `void activeSession?.abort()` before returning the large tool result, and the test queues only the single `[fauxAssistantMessage([fauxToolCall("big_out", {}, { id: "call-1" })], { stopReason: "toolUse" })]` response for the aborted `session.prompt(...)` (verified: no second provider call is made, `turn_end` stages the persisted result, and `agent_before_settle` is skipped).
4. `10.3`: pass `extensionFactories: [competitor, taiknr, helperExtension]` for the before-taiknr redaction case and `[taiknr, competitor, helperExtension]` for the after-taiknr survival case, with `competitor` reading `ctx.sessionManager.getBranch().findLast((e) => e.type === "message" && e.message.role === "toolResult")?.id`.
5. `10.4`: use `SettingsManager.inMemory({ compaction: { enabled: false, keepRecentTokens: 0 } })` (keeping auto-compaction off during prompts), run one settled `big_out` prompt followed by one short text prompt (`[fauxAssistantMessage([fauxText("done 2")], { stopReason: "stop" })]`) so `taiknr-side-store` precedes `firstKeptEntryId` on `getBranch()`, then queue two summary responses (`[fauxAssistantMessage([fauxText("history summary")], { stopReason: "stop" }), fauxAssistantMessage([fauxText("turn prefix summary")], { stopReason: "stop" })]`, required because `keepRecentTokens: 0` splits the tail turn) before `await session.compact()`, and assert `sideStoreIndex < firstKeptIndex` on `getBranch()` and `errors` empty.
